query:
SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM (
               SELECT e.app_user FROM enrollment e
                WHERE e.app_user = $2
                  AND e.class_course IN (SELECT id FROM class_course WHERE course = $1)
               UNION ALL
               SELECT m.app_user FROM course_membership m
                WHERE m.course = $1 AND m.app_user = $2
           ) people LIMIT 1
